SELECT c.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS contacted_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load e WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS stg_rows
FROM dim_campaign c WHERE campaign_name ILIKE '%garden%' OR campaign_name ILIKE '%spring%'

calls.statement:
WITH e AS (
 SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to,
   CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', e.contact_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS contact_date
 FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19)
SELECT count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) ids,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) no_member,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE delivered) delivered_members,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)) in_holdout,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT marketing_consent) no_consent_rows,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT marketing_consent) no_consent_members,
 min(contact_date) mind, max(contact_date) maxd,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE contact_date NOT BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) outside_validity,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE contact_date < DATE '2026-05-04' OR contact_date > DATE '2026-05-24') outside_window,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT campaign_id, member_id FROM campaign_holdout GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_holdout
FROM e

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS bdate, s.store_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
 LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) rl,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) buyers, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE store_id=900) web_net,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE store_id=900) web_lines,
 min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM lines WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted) AND bdate BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

WITH targeted AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected'))
SELECT s.store_id=900 AS is_web, w.web_order_id IS NULL AS no_dispatch, f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AS sale_in_window,
 COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AS bdate_in_window,
 count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.net_amount) minnet, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.quantity<=0) nonpos_qty,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.channel_code='WB') wb
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)
 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-27' OR w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-27')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH targeted AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
spend AS (
 SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_spend
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)
   AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND(net_spend,2) AS net_spend_eur FROM spend
